acts.name: The Drowned Stair

acts.ties: Brine Slug, Gull Thief, Coral Crab, Tide Leech, Kelp Lurker, Rust Knight, Spore Pod, Glimmer Wisp; bosses Leviathan Bell, Kelp Matriarch
acts.arc: Dawn → green gloom → rain. Light falls as the stair climbs.

acts.arc: Dusk rain → lantern-lit interiors → night storm on the walls.

acts.name: The Galecrown
acts.biome: A storm-wrapped summit above a sea of cloud: cliffs, lightning spires, hail-swept terraces

acts.name: The Pale Lighthouse
acts.biome: Above the storm: a silent, lightless summit, a pale lighthouse, and a sun drowned beneath a glass-black sea
acts.arc: Total stillness → a black-gold dawn from below the horizon.

sky.note: Static backdrop; cloud strip may scroll

far.note: Distant silhouettes, low contrast; static after slide-in

ground.note: Floor figures stand on; ground line at 69% height (anchored to .scene bottom)

fg.note: Edge framing only (outer 18% each side of the 19.5:9 frame), drawn over figures, ≤35% opacity where it crosses them. Ships as two files, fg-l and fg-r, in one fg layer

export.note: two files; each side spans at most the outer 18% of the 3120 frame plus 240 px overscan (802 px)

transitions.visual: “Tide wipe”: a wave-edged mask sweeps left→right over the map in the band’s deep colour; env swaps at full cover; mask exits right
transitions.timing: 450 ms in · swap · 350 ms out; then camera settle 900 ms (layers slide in from +4% x)

transitions.visual: No env change; scene dims to 55% behind the reward panel (no blur: too costly on mobile)
Crossfade to the act’s room scene; scene dimmed behind panels (event 50%, shop 30%, camp 25%, chest 20%)
Crossfade back; parchment slides up 24 px while fading in
Toast banner “Entering the Kelp Colonnade” over the map; map backdrop crossfades to the new band
Same wipe, but the wave edge is crimson (elite) or violet (Galecrowned) and a 120 ms low thump flash
Iris close to black (circle), 400 ms hold on the boss name, iris open on the lair
transitions.timing: 450 ms close · 400 ms hold · 600 ms open

transitions.moment: Act transition / run start / final act
transitions.visual: Fade to black → travel scene plays → title card fades in at 0.8 s for 2.2 s → fade to black → new act map
transitions.timing: Fade 400 ms · travel 3–6 s (skippable after 1 s) · fade 400 ms
transitions.reduced_motion: Static title card on the act’s map backdrop for 1.5 s, tap to continue

transitions.visual: Victory: ending_lit (final) or crossfade to the current lair with a gold wash; defeat: current env desaturates to 15% over 1.2 s

map_blur.note: pre-blurred quarter-size sky/far for map backdrops

world_notes: The tower IS the Drowned Stair. Act 1 isn't a separate shore beside a tower: every Act 1 scene stands on the tower's drowned base.
`a1_shore` is the tidal shelf and lowest landings of the tower's outer stair. The tower's mass rises to the right and out of frame, and its upper spiral fades into mist.
The view of the tower from across the water appears only in `tr_start` (*Rowing to the Stair*).
Sea stacks carved with steps are toppled buttresses or broken stair sections of the tower, not natural rocks.
Gulls: ambient gulls are small, generic silhouette particles (the `birds` effect).

export: art/v2/bg/<id-kebab>-<layer>@1x.webp (sky, far only; optional half size)
file_naming.density_reference: @1x/@2x relative to a 1560x720 reference layout; @2x = S24 native 3120x1440 or wider

trim.rect_where: envs.<id>.export.layers.<image>.rect (images: sky, far, mid, ground, fg_l, fg_r)

frame.target: Galaxy S24 Ultra landscape 3120x1440 (19.5:9), 832x384 CSS px
frame.hud_quiet_zone: upper-left corner under the HUD (top 21%): no bright features; light source at ~25-32% across, 28-34% down, mist-softened

budget.decoded_main_lever: trim mid and fg to content bounds

a1_shore.name: Shoreline Steps
a1_shore.mood: Hopeful, cold dawn; the climb begins
a1_shore.features: The tidal shelf and lowest landings of the tower’s own outer stair (not a separate shore): wet stone steps rising to the right into the tower’s mass, which runs out of frame right; tidepools with starfish and anemones; stepped sea stacks that are toppled buttresses and broken stair sections; the tower’s upper spiral fading into mist; ambient gulls as small silhouette particles only (never painted)

layers.sky: Peach dawn gradient, low sun at about 25–32% across and 28–34% down, in the sky or far layer, softened by mist with no hard glow (the hero zone stays low-contrast); it still reads as the upper-left key light. Thin cloud strip (scrolls 2 px/s)
layers.far: Stepped sea stacks (toppled buttresses and broken stair sections) in mist; the tower’s base rising out of frame right, its upper spiral fading into mist
layers.mid: Broken stair arch and a toppled pillar
